reviews.text:
We chose Weisz Selection based on wanting more of a boutique style pool builder versus a mass pool builder. From the start, Holden and  Ryan were so great to work with as far as getting me all of the information needed to submit to our HOA. The moment we signed the paperwork, they were working on permits and everything needed for approval on their end. They moved so fast we had city approval before HOA approval.
Weisz Selection built a beautiful pool for us. Was everything completely smooth, no, but they did what they needed to make the adjustments and turn it back into a smooth process. This is what I appreciated during the building phase, a team that works together to make the customer happy.  Since they did a great job with our pool, we called them back to put artificial turf down in our entire backyard as well as landscaping along our fence. We love our yard so much now! Jason, Holden, Ryan, John & Keith are all amazing to work with!
The attached picture is before we called them back to turf the yard and put Mexican pebble along the trees.
reviews.author: Courtney Johnson

reviews.text:
Jason and his crew at Weisz Selection are top-notch. From their design, which was well presented & gave us our first wow, to every other step, they’ve been professional, courteous, and always on time — which is rare in construction! We compared several builders, and Weisz clearly stood out for quality and reliability.
We even added landscaping design to our project because Jason’s ideas were spot-on. The pool is progressing right on schedule and looks incredible. Highly recommend this company for anyone wanting a high-end, stress-free pool and outdoor project.
reviews.author: Jeff Lynch

reviews.text: I contacted Weisz Selection to design and install shrub and flower beds for the front of my home and could not be happier with the results!  Their fast response from initial contact, excellent communication throughout the process, design knowledge and timeliness of completion was exceptional.
reviews.author: Angela Cantrell

reviews.text:
We recently completed a project with Weisz Selections and couldn’t be happier with the outcome.  Jason Weisz and his team were fantastic from the design stage all the way through the completion of the project.

Lance Blanks was our our project manager and was great to work with.  Any question we had along the way were quickly answered and he was always quick to reply.  I’d highly recommend Weisz Selections to anyone in the market for any outdoor project.
reviews.author: Jeff Teague

reviews.text: We have used Weisz Selection for a long time.  They have done 2 of our pools, 3 of our outdoor living areas, and to many to count landscaping jobs!  I met the owner over 30 years ago and he and his team have been great for us over the years!  They have always completed jobs in a timely manner, done a great job from start all the way to final cleanup!  They have ALWAYS backed their work with a fast and friendly warranty.  Even when outside of warranty they have worked with us in some form or fashion to keep us happy.  We recommend Weisz Selection 110% and currently in the planning of another project now!
reviews.author: James Mentesana

reviews.text: We recently completed a project with Weisz, and we couldn’t be more happy with our new addition. Our backyard was completely transformed and we have gained so much more living space. I can’t say enough about the team at Weisz. Everyone we worked with from start to finish, was professional and efficient. Their quality of work is top notch and absolute perfection! We are looking forward to spending many years in our gorgeous new backyard.
reviews.author: Kasey Ramirez

reviews.text: We’ve had a great experience so far working with Jason. The team has been very easy to work with — professional, responsive, and always willing to listen. data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic with strong signals of genuine customer experiences. The high ratings on primary platforms (Google, Houzz) are supported by detailed, varied reviews. The lower Yelp rating is based on minimal data and is an outlier. No concerning complaint patterns were found in the provided data.
fake_signals: All sampled Google reviews are 5-star, no critical reviews in sample
Some reviews are very generic and lack specific project details
authentic_signals: Multiple reviews mention specific team members (Holden, Ryan, Jason, Lance)
Reviews reference specific project types (pools, landscaping, patio covers)
Varied writing styles and perspectives (homeowners, repeat customers)
Some reviews mention timelines and process details (HOA permits, schedules)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google (4.6) and Houzz (4.7) ratings are high and consistent, but Yelp (3.6) is significantly lower. However, Yelp has only 5 reviews, which is a very small sample size and may not be representative. The high-volume platforms (Google, Houzz) tell a more consistent story.
